cost.time: not instrumented per-run (subagent wall clock ~1-3 min each); total eval round under 10 min
cost.tokens: not captured by the harness for subagents
cost.note: honest limitation: only pass-rate delta is measured; time/token delta is qualitative

stability.note: single run per configuration; d/dx stability unmeasured. Repeat once on next iteration.

conclusion: 每条用例的 with_skill 都命中了 skill 引入的区分性断言，without_skill 均在对应断言上失败；未出现双配置恒过的断言（3 条的 must_not_claim 类断言两方都过，已标注但不作为区分依据）
